senses.gloss: m. pl. (בלש 2); cmp. פלש, a. b. h. פלס) those who cut through (cmp. בקע a. deriv.), whence ground-diggers. (Maim.).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a">B. Mets. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דמחוזא</he> Ar. Var. (ed. a. Ar. <he>אכ׳</he> q. v.; Ms. M. <he>אוכלסי</he>, Ms. R. <he>אכלוזי</he>) the ground-diggers (working men) of M.
